hypothesis: The default locking provider is in-memory, so the lock taken around createReservationItems (and the cart lock in completeCartWorkflow) only serializes requests inside one Medusa process. The availability check in ensureInventoryLevels reads available_quantity and the reserved_quantity update is an absolute write with no row lock. With two servers on one database, two completions of carts that each need the single SOLO unit can both pass the check and both reserve it, giving live reservations above stocked quantity (no_oversell) and possibly a reserved counter mismatch.
submitted_scenario:
schema: oversold.scenario/v1
name: solo-race-two-servers
description: Two carts each hold the single SOLO unit, prepared on different servers and completed together so the in-memory locks cannot serialize them.
target:
  engine: medusa
  version: 2.22.0
  servers: 2
stock:
  SOLO: 1
carts:
  alice:
    server: 1
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
  bob:
    server: 2
    lines:
    - sku: OVS-SOLO
      qty: 1
race:
- id: alice-completes
  server: 1
  do: complete
  cart: alice
- id: bob-completes
  server: 2
  do: complete
  cart: bob
timing:
  release: together
  jitter_ms:
  - 0
  - 3
faults: []
runs: 50
seed: 7
